doc: The helper called with python floats (it returns numpy float64 scalars): below, on the edges, inside and above the window a = -0.5, b = 1.5. Float64 closed form: rtol 1e-9. Measured: one-ulp nudges of the float parameters change it by at most 2.2e-16 (worst of 6 random trials); the tolerance is more than 1e5 times that spread.
